name: tweetId
label: Post ID
help: Parent post ID whose replies (conversation) you want to fetch.

name: paginationToken
label: Pagination Token
help: next_token from a previous run to fetch the next page.

name: idempotencyKey
label: Idempotency Key
help: Leave empty to treat an identical retry as the same operation. Set a new value to repeat an identical operation on purpose.
